items.source: A PersistentEntity interface with additional methods for metadata related to Neo4j. Both Spring Data methods PersistentEntity.doWithProperties(PropertyHandler) and PersistentEntity.doWithAssociations(AssociationHandler) are aware which field of a class is meant to be mapped as a property of a node or a relationship or if it is a relationship (in Spring Data terms: if it is an association).
items.translation: 一个带有与 Neo4j 相关元数据额外方法的 PersistentEntity 接口。Spring Data 方法 PersistentEntity.doWithProperties(PropertyHandler) 和 PersistentEntity.doWithAssociations(AssociationHandler) 均知晓类中的哪个字段应被映射为节点的属性、关系的属性，或是关系本身（在 Spring Data 术语中：是否为关联）。
